what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in Ethiopia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 162126 Eritrean refugees in Ethiopia, which is 29.2% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia is the largest host of Eritrean refugees, followed by Sudan, Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000, reaching war level, and again in 2016.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea in 1997, 1999 and 2003, with EIJM - AS as the opposition group in 1999 and 2003.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Eritrea.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 3276 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 181091, at the end of 2020, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2025.
The data shows large changes between 2006 and 2007 and between 2008 and 2009.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Ethiopia they live.
These are year-end totals of refugees from Eritrea in Ethiopia only, reported to UNHCR.
